title: Restrictful
description: Restricts certain features for creative servers.
body:
**⛔ Restrictful limits potentially dangerous game features on your server.**
**🪶 Features:** - Entity Spawn blocking - Block Place blocking - Entity Interact blocking - Item Use blocking - Creative Item blocking
**🏓 Game versions:** - 1.21.x
**🔳 All the blocking features listed above have both a whitelist and a blacklist mode.**
